regime_context: The detector shows a broad, two-horse leadership structure in Canada: Base Metals & Copper narrowly ahead of Oil & Gas Producers (margin 0.11, not one-narrative). Both are eligible and uncrowded, but the leader carries a mean-revert Hurst tag, so the read is a moderate-quality trend regime with no confirmed handoff yet. Given track_record dir_accuracy of 0.347 (worse than coin-flip on direction) and only the absolute-trend gate validated, all leans are held at low conviction.
emerging_watch: Watch for a confirmed leadership handoff from Base Metals & Copper to Oil & Gas Producers: if XEG.TO closes above XBM.TO on 20-day relative performance AND XEG.TO breadth holds above 0.55 for five consecutive sessions, the two-horse structure retires toward a single energy-led narrative.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: XBM.TO holds the top rank and is eligible under the absolute-trend gate, giving it the one validated stay-in-regime property (drawdown control) on the TSX history. Breadth of 0.556 is the strongest among the top three and it is not crowded. Its mean-revert Hurst tag tempers enthusiasm, so this is a direction lean only, not a high-conviction re-rate call.
evidence: durability_bar 0.5 is at the neutral midpoint — cohesion is moderate, not exceptional
theses.dissent: Cross-sectional rank-IC is ~0 (backtest_verdict.relative_momentum modest_or_none), so the leadership rank itself has no validated forward return edge; a mean-revert Hurst tag on the leader suggests the recent move may partially unwind.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO closes below its 50-day moving average and XEG.TO overtakes it on 20-day relative performance before the check-by date

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: XEG.TO is the confirmed challenger, ranked 2nd, eligible, uncrowded, and actually has the highest breadth (0.571) of any theme plus a higher durability_bar (0.61). The rotation margin to the leader is thin (0.11), making it a legitimate second leg of the same broad commodities leadership rather than a third-place laggard.
evidence: breadth 0.571 (highest in the entire ranks table)
hurst_tag mixed (less mean-reversion risk than the leader)
theses.dissent: Energy is a crowded global macro trade and the detector gives no forward timing edge; if crude cracks on macro policy headlines, the breadth advantage evaporates quickly. Momentum rank itself is an attention lens with ~0 predictive IC.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO closes below its 50-day moving average and lags XBM.TO by more than 5% on 20-day relative performance before the check-by date

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: XGD.TO is eligible and ranked 3rd, but its breadth has already collapsed to 0.40 and durability_bar is 0.48 with a mean-revert Hurst tag. This looks like a late, thinning leader rather than an emerging one — without the breadth or trend-health of the top two, the stay-in-regime logic is weaker.
evidence: score 1.07 is a clear step down from the 1.545–1.655 top cluster
theses.dissent: Gold miners can spike on geopolitical headlines, and the macro_narrative shows geopolitics as a dominant theme; a safe-haven bid could re-ignite XGD despite weak breadth. This is an avoid, not a short.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO breadth re-expands above 0.50 and it closes back above its 50-day moving average on rising volume before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
